/// <summary>固定業務入力・応答・独立期待値を、一意な SHA-256 行で実行します。</summary>
[Trait("Category", "Business")]
public sealed class BusinessCasesTests : IClassFixture<BusinessRun>
{
    private readonly BusinessExecution execution;
    /// <summary>Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="BusinessCasesTests"/> class.</summary>
    /// <param name="run">全行で共有する証跡。業務状態は共有しません。</param>
    public BusinessCasesTests(BusinessRun run) => execution = run.Execution;
    // MemberData は文字列だけを事前列挙し、JsonNode や実行境界を渡しません。
    /// <summary>文字列の行識別子だけを発見します。</summary>
    /// <returns>factory を実行しない静的な行。</returns>
    public static IEnumerable<object[]> Cases()
    {
        var items = BusinessCases.Inspect(Review.Root()).Cases;
        if (items.Count == 0) yield return new object[] { "unconfigured", "" };
        foreach (var item in items)
        {
            var key = BusinessExecution.CaseKey(item.Case["caseId"]!.GetValue<string>());
            yield return new object[] { key[..32], key[32..] };
        }
    }
    /// <summary>登録集合の不正と必須欠落を拒否します。</summary>
    [Fact]
    public void BusinessCases_Integrity() => execution.VerifyIntegrity();
    /// <summary>一ケースを新しい境界で実行し、失敗も証跡と xUnit に伝えます。</summary>
    /// <param name="keyPrefix">元 ID の SHA-256 前半。runner に省略されない長さです。</param>
    /// <param name="keySuffix">元 ID の SHA-256 後半。</param>
    /// <returns>実行と破棄の完了。</returns>
    [Theory]
